title: Visionary slang
summary: How Visionaries talk about the hunt and each other.

claims.text: Each Visionary starts with private words tied to a personal theory of the hunt; as they meet, they begin sorting hunters into those who would destroy monsters, those who would fit them into society and those who only want to escape their influence.
Common terms include the adversaries for monsters, the challenge or in the field for the hunt, the big idea for a Visionary's theory and revelation for the imbuing.

Labels for their own kind include homebody, lurker or skulker, micro-manager, crackhead, prophet and tunnel visionary; other hunters call them thinkers, pathfinders, philosophers, navel-gazers and wayfarers.
Prophets, who try to turn their ideals into a religion, are generally mistrusted by other Visionaries.
